goal: Implement the version-1 durable release architecture as a safe, deterministic path from release decision through intent, trust, graph capability, crash-safe execution, and CLI/CI migration, without allowing existing PublishPlan routes to authorize effects.
requirement_note: No requirement@1 records exist for these REQ-less release specs. This plan is deliberately linked directly to the six specs; requirement backfill is a repository-process task and must not be fabricated here.
architecture: The dependency direction is strict: graph computes the policy decision; model owns only serializable typed identities, canonical transcripts, durable intent/state/receipt schemas; vcs owns fresh Git trust and lock evidence; graph turns a durable intent plus fresh observation into an opaque capability containing private prepared inputs; the ordered executor consumes that capability and ApplyPermit; CLI and CI are adapters. Layer 1 never depends on graph/vcs/providers, and no generic fingerprint, raw config bytes, endpoint, credential, workspace path, provider output, PublishPlan, or cache becomes durable authority.
tech_stack: OS-backed advisory lock crate only after API review

execution_rules.tdd: Every behavior-changing task starts with a focused RED test or a documented regression-proof test when the preceding task already implements the behavior. GREEN is followed by the named moon/just verification. Never introduce a temporary unsafe implementation merely to make a test red.
execution_rules.ordering: Batches execute in order. Tasks within a batch may run in parallel only when their files and public APIs do not overlap; integration tasks wait for all predecessors. No provider effect code starts before capability, state, and observation contracts are green.
execution_rules.commits: Commit only one verified semantic interval at a time using the task's conventional commit. Do not combine model, VCS, graph, executor, and interface changes in one commit.
execution_rules.verification: Use moon or just for Rust verification: moon run callisto-model:test, moon run callisto-vcs:test, moon run callisto-graph:test, moon run callisto-cli:test, just fmt-check, just lint, just test, and just ci. Focused test filtering is configured through the task runner where available; raw cargo commands are not the acceptance verification path.
execution_rules.gates: After each batch, run an independent mutation/review gate. The final exit gate re-reads all specs, maps every AC to tests/code, runs just ci, checks release routes structurally, and verifies the worktree is limited to planned files plus intentionally added tests/docs/workflow files.

prototype_disposition.rule: Before T01, inventory every uncommitted or prior foundation/prototype release file against these six specs. Retain only code that passes the task's RED/GREEN tests without weakening its assertions; otherwise delete it or revert it in the same semantic interval before new implementation begins.
known_rejections: Do not retain generic ReleaseInputComponentV1 kind/fingerprint fields or raw configuration-byte hashing.
Do not retain graph validation based on a cached Workspace, caller-supplied SHA, manual registry URL parsing, or a capability lacking per-operation prepared inputs.
Do not retain executor logic where !is_failure or absence of a record implies success.
Do not retain PublishPlan/PLAN_JSON as a durable intent, identity, or mutation authority.
prototype_disposition.verification: Record the inventory and disposition in the task commit body or a test-only comment; `git diff --check` and targeted tests must pass after cleanup.

batches.description: Inventory/discard unsafe prototypes and establish a clean TDD baseline.
Graph-owned deterministic release roster and explanations.
Layer-1 typed durable decision/intent, bindings, DAG, artifact slots, and canonical validation.
VCS-owned clean detached Git evidence and workspace exclusion lock.
Fresh graph re-observation, safe endpoint preparation, and opaque validated authority.
Atomic state/receipt, observation-driven reconciliation, provider adapter contracts, and artifact-manifest binding.
CLI migration, GitHub plan/build/execute topology, docs, and removal of legacy mutation authority.
Independent mutation, security, and spec-compliance exit gate.

tasks.description: Inventory the existing model/graph/VCS/reconciliation prototypes and discard or isolate every implementation that violates the new typed-boundary contract before extending it.
tasks.red: Add characterization tests proving generic raw fingerprint acceptance, cached-workspace acceptance, caller-supplied source substitution, manual URL acceptance, and absence-of-failure success are rejected by the intended new public boundaries; record which tests reveal prototype violations.
tasks.green: Remove/replace rejected prototype paths; preserve only existing code that meets the characterization contract without compatibility shims granting authority.

tasks.description: Add graph-owned ReleaseDecisionV1 derivation from exact qualified CLI selection or a named configuration-selection mode and fresh configuration/discovery, including non-overlapping linked-group closure, configured fixed-group/cascade/prerelease rules, exact qualified roster entries, target versions, and closed inclusion reasons.
tasks.red: Table tests first: exact CLI selection, named configuration selection, overlapping linked-group configuration rejection, fixed/cascade expansion, prerelease off-roster exclusion, empty selection rejection, conflicting target versions, same bare name across ecosystems, and safe miette diagnostics.
tasks.green: Implement using existing group/cascade/prerelease semantics only; emit a serializable graph result without PublishPlan dependency or effects.
tasks.commit: feat(graph): derive explicit durable release decisions

tasks.description: Define decision canonical ordering and DecisionDigest transcript, independent of discovery order, HashMap iteration, enum declaration order, source formatting, and wall clock.
tasks.red: Permutation tests reorder packages, groups, edges, and reasons and assert byte-identical canonical decision data/digest; a targeted DepKind declaration-order regression proves the explicit semantic key is used.
tasks.green: Use BTree collections or documented sorted vectors and the versioned length-prefixed transcript primitive; do not serialize Debug/Ord output as authority.

tasks.description: Replace broad release-intent prototype fields with closed Layer-1 semantic snapshot types, exact ReleaseOperationId variants, explicit prerequisite DAG, artifact slots, strict schema validation, and IntentDigest.
tasks.red: Golden/permutation and negative tests first: malformed/unknown fields, digest mismatch, duplicate qualified operation identity, bare-name ecosystem collision, missing/self/cyclic prerequisites, invalid canonical order, omitted/default ambiguity, and semantic-one-field digest mutation.
tasks.green: Implement typed parsing/validation and stable Kahn ordering in model without graph/VCS/URL/provider dependencies; retain the versioned length-prefixed SHA-256 transcript.
tasks.commit: feat(model): define typed durable release intent

tasks.description: Add durable RegistryBindingId/BindingDigest and artifact provenance coverage, ensuring the model cannot retain endpoints, credentials, raw bytes, or unclassified serialized authority fields.
tasks.red: Tests prove distinct normalized bindings cannot collide, equivalent accepted bindings converge at the graph/model boundary, unsafe endpoint forms are rejected before model construction, and a serialized-field/provenance mismatch fails coverage.
tasks.green: Make provenance a closed schema companion and keep URL normalization/parsing in graph; model receives only typed logical key plus digest.
tasks.commit: feat(model): bind release operations to safe remote identities

tasks.description: Expose structured VCS trust observation: canonical repository-root binding, detached exact CommitSha, clean tracked/untracked status, OS-backed release lock outside checkout, and effect-time recheck.
tasks.red: Real temporary-repository tests first for non-Git/nested roots, symbolic HEAD, mismatch, dirty tracked/untracked files, lock contention/drop release, shallow/inspection failure, and changed source between validation and recheck. Recording fake adapters prove failures precede effects.
tasks.green: Use structured Git observation and typed miette errors; select a maintained OS lock crate only after checking cross-platform exclusive-lock and drop semantics. Keep lock path/handle private and non-serializable.
tasks.commit: feat(vcs): bind durable releases to fresh Git trust

tasks.description: Build a fresh graph observation boundary that acquires trust/lock, reconstructs decision/snapshot/operations from disk, compares exactly with received intent, and returns opaque non-Clone/non-Serde ValidatedReleaseIntent only on a complete match.
tasks.red: Independent workspace fixtures first for changed manifest/config/policy/selection/roster/version/edge/DAG/source/slot/registry binding, source substitution, duplicate/cycle, and equivalent insertion permutations; every rejection asserts zero fake adapter calls.
tasks.green: Construct a new observation boundary rather than reading Workspace interior caches. Keep fields private and capability non-forgeable; compare typed values, never raw config/Debug/display strings.
tasks.commit: feat(graph): authorize fresh durable release intents

tasks.description: Prepare operation-specific private inputs during the same successful observation: package directories, parsed safe endpoints, exact tag/annotation policy, forge bindings, and artifact slots, keyed by exact operation ID.
tasks.red: Tests prove URL userinfo/query/fragment rejection, normalized-equivalence behavior, prepared input retention, exact-ID-only selection, and that neither a plan nor mutable config can reconstruct an operation after authorization.
tasks.green: Use the URL crate only in graph, redact endpoint values from diagnostics, and expose at most a narrow internal prepared-operation accessor to the future executor.
tasks.commit: feat(graph): prepare private release effect inputs

tasks.description: Implement typed intent-bound execution state and receipt with complete roster validation, monotonic Pending→Attempting→terminal transitions, atomic outside-checkout default/override persistence, and closed safe outcomes.
tasks.red: Tests simulate crash after Attempting persistence, stale/mismatched state, invalid transition, incomplete roster, terminal rewrite, duplicate/mismatched receipt, unsafe serialized field, and default state path outside root.
tasks.green: Use callisto_model::atomic::atomic_write for complete state rewrites; never use absence of failure as success and never serialize diagnostics/provider strings/operational paths.
tasks.commit: feat(release): persist durable execution state and receipts

tasks.description: Add the ordered coordinator and narrow observation/effect adapter contracts. Reconcile Pending/Attempting by exact identity, run trust/prerequisite rechecks under lock before each dispatch, and make conflicting/ambiguous existing remote objects safe non-successes.
tasks.red: Recording adapters model interruption before call, provider-side success before persistence, exact existing object, conflicting tag/registry/forge object, ambiguous response, changed HEAD, and unattempted prerequisite; assert no dependent unauthorized calls.
tasks.green: Dispatch only through ValidatedReleaseIntent plus ApplyPermit and exact operation IDs. Registry proof keys package/version/binding; tag proof checks target/annotation policy; forge proof checks tag/target binding. No parallel execution, retries, or generic boolean observation results.
tasks.commit: feat(release): reconcile effects from exact provider evidence

tasks.description: Implement ArtifactManifestV1 and verified GitHub artifact-attestation proof for declared binary slots, bound to intent digest and exact source commit, without coupling source registry publishing to binary uploads.
tasks.red: Tests cover missing/duplicate/unexpected slot, wrong platform/version/source/intent, byte SHA/length mismatch, manifest substitution, unverified/wrong-repository/wrong-workflow/wrong-source attestation, and source registry publish with no binary slot consumption.
tasks.green: Validate manifest schema and all downloaded bytes before binary adapter construction; cryptographically verify the exact artifact against the configured GitHub repository and immutable signer workflow, then check the provenance source commit. Use typed slots/digests and no arbitrary durable paths.

tasks.description: Introduce release plan/inspect/execute/reconcile and migrate legacy plan-publish/publish/tag --plan/filter-plan to explicitly read-only compatibility previews; only release execute may obtain ApplyPermit and adapters.
tasks.red: CLI integration tests with recording adapters exercise every command and malformed/stale input path: plan/inspect/reconcile/legacy commands have zero effects, execute requires explicit intent and required manifest, and only execute reaches permit/effect dispatch.
tasks.green: Use explicit file paths, no checkout search/inline JSON/default plan recomputation. Preserve legacy display behavior only where it is non-authoritative and label migration replacements in help/errors.
tasks.commit: feat(cli): route releases through durable execution

tasks.description: Replace single-job/composite mutable release handoff with GitHub plan/build/execute jobs, same-run artifact and attestation verification, Environment-gated privilege, least permissions, SHA-pinned actions, policy checks, and CODEOWNERS coverage.
tasks.red: Workflow/static harness tests first assert no execute credentials in plan/build, build-only id-token/attestations permissions, one attestation per binary, explicit job boundaries, same-run artifact download, intent/source/artifact/attestation verification before execute, immutable action SHAs, no cache authority paths, named Environment, and environment API check rejecting no reviewers.
tasks.green: Keep composite action unprivileged/read-only or setup-only. Document administrator verification of live Environment rules; do not claim YAML alone enforces review protection.
tasks.commit: feat(ci): gate durable release execution by verified artifacts

tasks.description: Document local and CI plan/build/execute/reconcile recovery including detached-clean Git requirement, linked-group roster behavior, source crate versus binary asset distinction, outside-checkout local state, explicit CI state artifact, and cache prohibition.
tasks.red: Documentation contract test/grep first asserts obsolete mutable PublishPlan workflow and cache-as-recovery guidance are absent, and required durable-flow terms are present.
tasks.green: Update the existing authority-classified operational docs without rewriting historical/rationale documents as current behavior.
tasks.commit: docs(release): document durable local and CI recovery flow

tasks.description: Independent adversarial exit gate: map every acceptance criterion to code/tests, mutate critical invariants, audit all legacy mutation routes and durable schemas, and run full verification.
tasks.red: Manual mutation matrix: permit a generic fingerprint; use PackageId::matches; reorder DAG ties; use stale workspace; accept branch/dirty HEAD; skip Attempting write; treat absence of failure as success; leak endpoint into persisted bytes; allow legacy publish/tag effect; accept artifact SHA/source mismatch; accept an unverified, wrong-repository, wrong-workflow, or wrong-source artifact attestation; grant plan job write credentials. Each mutation must make a named test/policy check fail.
tasks.green: Restore implementation only after each mutation is caught. Produce an AC-to-test matrix and a route reachability audit showing release execute is the sole production effect entry.
tasks.commit: test(release): complete durable release architecture exit gate

batch_gates.gate: Independent graph reviewer validates policy compatibility, roster closure, exact qualified identity, and permutation coverage.
Independent model/security reviewer validates canonical transcript vectors, schema/provenance coverage, and absence of raw endpoint/config fields.
Independent VCS reviewer validates real detached/dirty/lock behavior and error redaction.
Capability reviewer attempts stale/cache/source-substitution/prepared-input bypasses with recording adapters.
Crash-recovery reviewer injects interruptions at every state/effect boundary and checks role-specific observation proof.
CLI/CI security reviewer traces all permit/effect call sites, workflow permissions, artifact checks, cache use, and GitHub Environment verification.

final_acceptance: Do not mark any spec accepted or claim release execution complete until T14 passes, all batch gates have clean findings or explicit fixed follow-ups, every planned semantic commit is present, and the full just ci result is green.
